open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Shhh… Noah, Ilyas, imagine with me: a huge, huge ship, built on dry land. And the people laugh at it.
s1b: Who would build something like that? Tonight I will tell you.
s1c: And do you know, Noah? This prophet has the same name as you.
s2a: The Prophet Noah, peace be upon him. A long time after Adam, people no longer lived the way Allah loves.
s2b: They made idols of stone and worshipped them. They even gave them names: Wadd, Suwa', Yaghuth, Ya'uq and Nasr. And they forgot Allah, who created them.
s3a: So Allah sent them a prophet: Noah. Noah said to his people: My people, worship no one but Allah. And ask Him for forgiveness, for He loves to forgive.
s3b: And do you know how long Noah stayed with them? Nine hundred and fifty years. He called them by night and by day, loudly and quietly.
s3c: Grandma, did they listen to him?
s3d: No, Ilyas. They put their fingers in their ears and covered their heads with their clothes, so they would not hear him. Only very few of them believed in Allah.
s4a: Then Allah said to Noah: Build the ship, We see you and We teach you. So Noah began to build. Day after day, plank after plank.
s4b: A ship? Here? On dry land?
s4c: Every time the leaders of his people passed by, they mocked him. But Noah said calmly: If you laugh at us now, you will soon know what will happen. Noah never gave up, and he trusted in Allah.
s5a: Then the day came. Allah said to Noah: When the water gushes out of the oven, carry in the ship a pair of every kind, and carry your family, except the one Allah has judged, and carry the believers.
s5b: And suddenly the water gushed out. Noah brought the animals into the ship, two by two. And he said: Get on board! In the name of Allah it sails, and in the name of Allah it comes to rest.
s6a: The gates of the sky opened with pouring water, and the earth burst into springs. And the ship sailed on waves like mountains. But one did not get on: Noah's own son. He was far away.
s6b: Noah called to him: My son, come and ride with us, and do not stay with those who do not believe. The son said: I will go up a high mountain that will protect me from the water. Noah said: Nothing protects today from Allah's command, except those Allah has mercy on. And a wave came between them, and the son drowned.
s7a: And Noah called to his Lord about his son, and he knew: Allah's promise is true, and Allah is the most just of all who judge.
s7c: Then Allah the Exalted said: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." That means: the water went down, and the ship came to rest on Mount Judi.
s8a: Then it was said: O Noah, come down from the ship, with peace from Allah and blessings, for you and for those with you. A new beginning on the earth.
s8b: Noah? … Ilyas? … They are asleep. Sleep peacefully, my little stars. And remember: even if others laugh, never stop doing what is right. Trust in Allah, for Allah is with those who are patient.
s8c: And tomorrow I will tell you about the Prophet Hud, and about a very, very strong people. Good night.
